name: Otokoyu ni Haittekita Onna no Ko o Dou Suru ka
original_name: 男湯に入ってきた女の子をどうするか
source:
Papa took his precious little girl to the bathhouse. The tanned, budding daughter gets teased!
Makeouts in the steamy water, mutual "playtime" washing, grappling bodies in the sauna. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095862.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
爸爸带着他心爱的小女儿去了澡堂。晒黑的、萌芽的女儿被嘲笑！
在热气腾腾的水中亲热，互相“玩耍”洗澡，在桑拿房里扭打身体。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095862.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
